description: This file defines the abstract class MaterialsProvider in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for cryptographic material handling within the AWS SDK's crypto module. It provides methods for key size support, generating encryption keys and IVs, and abstract methods to be implemented for encryption and decryption operations.

classes.name: MaterialsProvider
classes.description: Abstract class for managing cryptographic materials, providing support for key size validation, key generation, and abstract methods for encryption and decryption.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a given key size in bits is supported for AES encryption.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Abstract method to perform initialization based on metadata envelope.

methods.name: getMaterialsDescription
methods.description: Abstract method to get the material description for verification.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the name of the wrap algorithm.

methods.name: encryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to encrypt a content encryption key (CEK).

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to decrypt a content encryption key (CEK).

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a random content encryption key of specified size in bits.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector (IV) for a given OpenSSL cipher name.
